title: Close every node:sqlite handle a test opens before its folder goes, and before an assertion can fail
body: Register the close of a telemetry database (openTelemetry, DatabaseSync) in t.after before the folder's rmSync, or close it in the test before asserting: t.after callbacks run in registration order, Windows answers EPERM when a folder holds an open database, and a failing assertion before the close keeps node --test alive past its timeout with no output. Do not make --test-force-exit the default: it hides the hang (and once crashed server tests on Windows); a standalone script that opens a database ends with process.exit. Why: a store left open hung a server test for 120 s silently on 2026-09-22; the maintenance tests hit EPERM on 2026-10-13 until the handle closed before the folder was removed.
not_derivable: The tests close their handles, but not why the order matters, nor that a failing assertion hangs the runner without a word.

evidence.summary: Tests close the database before the temporary folder is removed.
openTelemetry returns a DatabaseSync the caller closes.
